Author: NightmareXIV
Name: C.Tools Lifestream
Punchline: A plugin to speed up Aethernet travel and World changing.
Description:
快捷传送
- One click to teleport to any world or aethernet destination
- Click on aetheryte shards inside zone map to teleport to them
Changelog:
- All movement issues related to legacy mode, controller and first person camera should be resolved
- Fixed an issue where using world change custom alias commands could cause wrong queue order
- Added new custom alias command kinds: Use_Return, Wait, Use_Plugin_Command, Send_Message
- Custom alias command selector will be ordered alphabetically now
- Added new command: `/li w Character Name@World` - combines relog + world travel in one command. Isn't really intended to be used manually, but serves as an addition for another update
